data_source: pypistats without_mirrors via frozen OSS Radar download_history export
target: log1p(sum of 28 future daily downloads) minus log1p(sum of last 28 observed daily downloads)
issuance: 12:00 UTC on the calendar day after the last observed date
outcome_start: UTC calendar day after issuance (observed cutoff + 2 days)

local_models.seasonal_naive: repeat the last observed seven-day sequence; forecast the unobserved bridge day, then the next 28 days
local_models.damped_ets: statsmodels ExponentialSmoothing: additive trend, damped trend, additive seasonality period 7, last 84 observations scaled by their mean; L-BFGS-B optimization without brute initialization; no bias removal; floor negative point forecasts at zero; seasonal-naive fallback on failed fit with explicit failure count

training_rule: All feature contexts end at their historical cutoff; all training outcomes must end on or before the current forecast's observed cutoff. No future labels, clipping, package identifiers, early stopping, feature selection, or hyperparameter search.
primary_metric: equal-package/equal-period mean absolute error in log growth
baseline_selection: select seasonal_naive or damped_ets by development primary error; freeze this baseline before reporting the final comparison
promotion_rule: No promotion from this benchmark alone. Only two final periods; require additional frozen prospective evidence before a production model claim.
missing_data_rule: Reject duplicate, missing, non-finite, non-integral, or negative observations. Never fill missing days with zero or drop a model's difficult test cases.
uncertainty: Paired package-cluster bootstrap over both final periods is descriptive and conditional on these two periods; it does not estimate general temporal uncertainty.
limitations: retrospective reconstructed availability, not vintage inputs
current curated watchlist selection, not random ecosystem sample
same packages in training and testing
download counts do not measure unique users or adoption
28-day benchmark is a different target from production's 70-day smoothed target; metrics are not directly comparable
